svg.title: Immutable approval and the dispatch acceptance lifecycle
svg.desc: Approval is a separate immutable record attached while a dispatch remains prepared. One D1 transaction verifies acceptance, reserves quota, inserts the outbox and moves to queued. A claimed attempt moves to submitting. Known outcomes are accepted or failed. An uncertain outcome becomes submission_unknown and requires reconciliation, never automatic resubmission. Accepted does not mean delivered.
